{{Quote|They staged a dummy strike on the collective's base on Nummunr a week ago. Hunter Maas escaped, but they've mobilized half the long-range scouting ships in the Core. According to the data, their orders are to find him and then call in the full strike force to kill him and anybody he might have shared the data with.|[[Scarlet Hark]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="HAT" />}}
